item.title: Didgeridoo 1.0.2
item.description: • The keys of the app's keyboard show an ochre band at their lower end. A click in the band overblows the note; a click anywhere else on a key never does, wherever Toot Vel stands. Before, the lowest part of a key overblew without showing it, and the key's name lay right across its edge, so a click on the name sometimes played the note 16 semitones too high. The names now sit above the band.
